tos_disclaimer_message:
Shiro is an open-source account management utility running locally on your computer.

Please note:
1. All communications occur directly between your device and Roblox endpoints without intermediary servers.
2. You are responsible for account security and compliance with Roblox Terms of Use.
3. Automation features (such as Anti-AFK) are opt-in and disabled by default.

Click OK to confirm and proceed.
